text:
lucy (PM): ACME reached back. their ask: early pilot of Optimize Advisor covering adaptive batching, cheap prefix cache, model quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. they want a short checklist + clear opt-out. can we scope a safe pilot?
ankit (Eng): I think we should keep pilot surface minimal: batching + prefix-cache on a single model family (redwood-3b). quant recs can be advisory only (no auto-switch) initially.
opal (SRE): ops requirements: p95 and p99 latency targets, cache backpressure handling, alert on >5% error rate increase. need runbook entries before any canary.
lucy (PM): propose targets: p95 <= 180ms, p99 <= 420ms at pilot qps (800 qps). cost uplift ceiling 12% for pilot. quant advisory must include expected BLEU-like delta on eval sets.
marta (ML): recommended quant tiers: "safe"=fp16 fallback, "fast"=int8 with per-layer calibration, "aggressive"=quant4 with calibration and eval gating. recs should include expected latency, cost delta, and eval delta.
ankit (Eng): rollout plan suggestion: feature flag + console toggle per-tenant, canary at 5% -> 20% -> 50% with automatic pause if eval-alert fires. we can reuse existing rollout infra but need variant-tagging and per-request metadata.
sam (ProdOps): customer ops ask: per-tenant toggle visible in console, ability to opt-out of any quant tier, and a scheduled maintenance window for the pilot. ACME needs the pilot window 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-24.
lucy (PM): acceptance checklist draft please. keep it short.
ankit (Eng): checklist v0:
```
- Batching: stable end-to-end on redwood-3b, config `opt.advisor.batching`
- Cache: prefix cache (LRU), togglable `opt.advisor.cache.prefix`
- Metrics: token-cost per request, variant tag, per-prompt eval probes
- Rollout: flag-based canary + auto-pause on eval-alerts
- Safety: per-tenant opt-out + maintenance window support
- Docs: short ops runbook & incident steps
```
lucy (PM): add gating rules: any prompt-set quality degradation >2.5% OR customer reported regressions -> immediate rollback. also require reproducible eval seed and stored traces.
marta (ML): I'll build a small eval harness that runs each night against ACME prompt sets and emits a concordance score. need consistent seeds + logits capture. estimate: 3 sprints for a minimal runner.
opal (SRE): add circuit-breaker rules: if cache hit-rate drops <10% and tail latency rises >30% -> disable cache for that tenant. also protect against cache storms (thundering herd).
sam (ProdOps): ops checklist: get ACME prompt set + target KPIs, confirm Dedicated capacity reservation, schedule kickoff w/ support.
launch-bot: Created ticket OPT-4309: "Advisor pilot — ACME narrow-scope" and attached acceptance checklist.
lucy (PM): owners: ankit -> batching & cache infra, marta -> quant recs + eval harness, opal -> runbook & SLOs, sam -> customer coordination. i'll draft timeline this afternoon. flag any blockers.
ankit (Eng): small ask: we need a console metric for "advisor.variant" and a tiny API header `x-opt-advisor=variant` so customers can opt-in/out at request granularity.
marta (ML): blocker: to produce reliable quant recs we need sample latency profiles for ACME workload (sequence length distribution). can sam get that from them?
sam (ProdOps): noted. i'll request sample logs and consent for telemetry.
lucy (PM): great. follow-up: i'll post a condensed checklist + dates and open a separate thread for rollout runbook edits. thanks all.
